messages:
Iris (AE): Kicking off Galeon Systems POC thread. They want to drop our runtime in place of their current provider with minimal code changes. Main asks: prompt parity for 3 critical flows, billing visibility, SSO/SCIM, and a dev sandbox for smoke. Can SE + Sec + Pricing chime in?

Deep (SE): Quick context: they send batched requests to /v1/complete (sync) today, ~250k tokens/day, mostly 30-120 token prompts. Concerned about answer drift and how we handle partial token charges on retries. Also want to preserve exact-match behaviour for their compliance templates.

Tom (Galeon Eng): Correct. We have ~150 golden prompts (legal templates) that must be byte-for-byte identical. For everything else, semantic parity is fine but they need a numeric metric. Can you run an automated parity run?

Deep (SE): Plan: 1) Provide a small adapter snippet to map /v1/complete -> /responses. 2) Run our parity harness with three metrics: exact-match rate (for golden set), average token delta, and embedding/similarity score for fuzzier prompts. 3) Provide logs and per-request token breakdown so they can reconcile billing.

Deep (SE): Adapter example (JSON body mapping):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/responses -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"input": "{{prompt}}", "max_tokens": {{max}}, "model": "redwood-infer-1"}'
```
(We can add a thin shim if they need header-preserving behaviour)

Priya (Security): BYOK/KMS: supported on Dedicated and Private. For Hosted we offer envelope encryption with our keys; customers requiring BYOK need Private or Dedicated with KMS integration. SSO/SCIM: available for console and team provisioning on enterprise plans.

Priya (Security): Also note: Galeon asked about prompt data retention and redaction. Our default is 90 days masked; we can extend retention on Dedicated or Private with a contractual addendum. Will need their security questionnaire filled.

Marco (Pricing): Two quick numbers to ballpark: Hosted per-token (generation): $0.007 / 1k tokens. Embedded/feature add-ons billed separately. Dedicated reserved estimate for their volume: ~$22k/month baseline (with 6mo term) which reduces effective per-token cost and guarantees capacity. Exact quote after invoice sharing.

Iris (AE): Tom, can you share the 150 golden prompts + a 500-sample set so we can run a quick smoke? If you share last 30 days token histogram it helps pricing.

Tom (Galeon Eng): Sharing via secure link shortly. Also need allowlistable IPs for sandbox.

infra-bot: sandbox-galeon deployment ready at https://staging.redwood.ai/galeon (id: 5012). Use key G_TEST_5012.

Deep (SE): Sandbox egress IPs for allowlist: 34.82.11.90/32, 34.82.11.91/32. For Dedicated we'll provide a /24 CIDR per region.

Tom (Galeon Eng): For acceptance tests we need: 1) Golden prompts exact match 100% 2) Overall semantic sim >= 0.94 (cosine) 3) Average token billing delta <= 3% 4) No 5xx during fallback to smaller quantized model. 5) p95 latency <300ms for short prompts on Dedicated.

Deep (SE): We'll run a 100-prompt smoke tonight and the full 650 prompt run (150 gold + 500 sample) during the POC week. I'll attach the harness and instructions to run locally or in our sandbox.

Marco (Pricing): I'll prepare two scenarios: hosted monthly vs 12mo reserved. I'll also show estimated savings if they enable prefix KV caching and 32-bit quantization where acceptable.

Priya (Security): I'll send over the prefilled vendor security questionnaire and highlight two legal review items: BYOK SLA and extended log retention. Also flag KMS rotation automation as a professional services line.

Iris (AE): Scheduling a 30m POC kickoff with Galeon, SE, Sec, and Pricing tomorrow 9am PT. Agenda: share golden set, review acceptance criteria, pricing options, and next steps for allowlisting.

Tom (Galeon Eng): Thanks all. If you can drop the adapter repo + quick runbook here, we'll start the smoke tonight.

Deep (SE): Repo: https://git.internal.redwood/integrations/galeon-adapter (readme has runbook). Dropping TL;DR: clone, set REDWOOD_KEY, run ./run_smoke.sh --sample 100.

Iris (AE): Noted. Marking CRM: galeon-system-swap-poc. Will follow up after kickoff. :white_check_mark:
